description: Curated safe, non-exploitative vulnerability indicators for FortifyOne VulnProbe. Expanded in v5.3.

templates.title: SSL Heartbleed indicator
templates.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to a patched version and rotate any exposed keys/certs.

templates.title: SSLv3 POODLE indicator
templates.remediation: Disable SSLv3 on all services; prefer TLS 1.2+.

templates.title: SSL CCS Injection indicator
templates.remediation: Patch OpenSSL / TLS stack; disable vulnerable cipher suites.

templates.title: SMB MS17-010 (EternalBlue) indicator
templates.remediation: Apply MS17-010 patches; block SMB from the internet; disable SMBv1.

templates.title: SMB MS08-067 indicator
templates.remediation: Patch legacy Windows systems; isolate or retire unsupported hosts.

templates.title: Anonymous FTP enabled
templates.remediation: Disable anonymous FTP; prefer SFTP with authentication.

templates.title: SSHv1 protocol supported
templates.remediation: Disable SSHv1; require SSH protocol 2 only.

templates.title: RDP exposed
templates.remediation: Remove public RDP; use VPN or zero-trust access with NLA and MFA.

templates.title: SMB exposed publicly
templates.remediation: Block SMB at the perimeter; never expose file shares to the internet.

templates.title: Telnet service exposed
templates.remediation: Disable Telnet; replace with SSH.

templates.title: Database port exposed
templates.remediation: Bind databases to localhost/private network; require VPN or bastion access.

templates.title: VNC exposed
templates.remediation: Do not expose VNC publicly; tunnel over VPN/SSH.

templates.title: Redis exposed
templates.remediation: Bind Redis to localhost; require AUTH; never expose to the internet.

templates.title: MongoDB exposed
templates.remediation: Enable authentication; bind to private interfaces only.

templates.title: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch exposed
templates.remediation: Require authentication; place behind VPN or reverse proxy with access control.

templates.title: HTTP Slowloris susceptibility indicator
templates.remediation: Tune web server timeouts and request limits; place behind a reverse proxy/WAF.

templates.title: Docker API potentially exposed
templates.remediation: Never expose the Docker daemon API to the network without TLS + auth.

templates.title: Kubernetes API / etcd exposure indicator
templates.remediation: Restrict Kubernetes control-plane and etcd ports to authorized networks only.

templates.title: LDAP / LDAPS exposed
templates.remediation: Do not expose directory services to the public internet; require VPN + strong auth.

templates.title: SMTP service on non-standard or high-risk exposure
templates.remediation: Ensure SMTP is not an open relay; enforce authentication and TLS.
